basis: raw vegetables are 80-95 percent water (food composition tables)
raw fruit is mostly free water
fish and shellfish flesh is about 70-80 percent water
milk, cream, yogurt, fresh cheese; hard and powdered dairy are lower in water but are not separated here
dried legumes are dry, soaked or canned ones are moist; the group does not say which
flour and dry grain are dry, dough, batter and cooked grain or bread are moist; the group does not say which
sauces and pastes are moist, salt and dry mixes are not
nuts and seeds are about 2-10 percent water
dried spices are dry, fresh herbs and aromatics are moist; the group does not say which
sugar is dry; honey and syrup keep about 17-30 percent water but behave as a low-moisture matrix
oils and fats carry no free water (butter and margarine carry about 16 percent and are not separated here)
